adjudication.rationale: In addGuestsHandler the PR appends new guests by creating Booking.attendees records via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) and then updates calendars/emails. The handler also propagates evt.seatsPerTimeSlot / evt.seatsShowAttendees into the CalendarEvent, but there is no diff evidence of any seat-capacity check or creation of seat-specific records/links when seatsPerTimeSlot is enabled. If the product’s “seats” feature relies on separate seat accounting, this change could make seat-based bookings inconsistent (guests exist as attendees but aren’t reflected in whatever seat tracking exists). The diff alone doesn’t prove the exact seat model/flows, but it does show the feature ignores seats entirely despite reading seat fields.
